ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය
අති විෙශෂ
No. 2373/35 – THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 29, 2024
EXTRAORDINARY

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose. Description of the land to be acquired: Allotments of Land in Extent of about 0.0196 Hectare, depicted in Cadastral Plan No. 420206, Zonal No. 07 and Sheet No. 02 dated 24.10.2023 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the village of Palle Gattuwana in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 717, Palle Gattuwana in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Mallawapitiya in Kurunegala District in North - Western Province. 01. Lot No. 01 Name of Land: Weli Kumbura; Description: Open Waste Land; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Ranathunga Arachchilage Irangani. (Acquired under Section 38(A) of Land Acquisition Act., To Finalise the land acquisition); Extent: 0.0196 Hectare.

North: Palle Gattuwana (A part); East: Palle Gattuwana (A part); South: Palle Gattuwana (A part); West: Lot No. 38 in Preliminary Plan No. Ku. 2478. All persons interested in the aforesaid land are hereby required to appear personally or by agent duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat of Mallawapitiya on the 29.04.2024 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notified to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 22.04.2024, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
W. P. C. N. Pൺඍඁංඋൺඇൺ, Divisional Secretary, Mallawapitiya. Divisional Secretariat, Mallawapitiya. 18.12.2023. EOG 02 - 0200
